mapping_rules.meaning: Existing Usiphu topics and objectives are cross-referenced to the institution's publicly described educational approach and broad medical graduate competencies. This is not a claim that the topic is an official Suez course, nor that the official course outcome has been verified.
required_to_upgrade: Obtain the current Suez University Faculty of Medicine bylaw PDF and course specifications from the faculty/portal
Extract course codes, years, semesters, module outcomes, contact hours and assessment methods
Map every official outcome to one or more Usiphu objectives
Have the Faculty of Medicine curriculum committee or designated clinical educators approve the crosswalk
